name: Kotiväli Homes
when: The customer is actively looking for a home to buy: searching listings, viewings, flats or houses for sale. Not when they only mention a plan years away.

feeText: Nordea gets 0.5% of the price if you buy through Kotiväli, and gives a quarter of it back to you.
